title: Exact-Head Installed Windows/Android Certification
selected_by_owner: Strict successor after owner-approved PCV-03 decomposition and PCV-03E completed_verified closeout; ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH supplies no interstitial override.
objective: A repaired exact-head Windows host and Android player pass automated predecessor regressions, package identity verification and causal physical-device evidence for join, authority, idempotency, hidden projection and reconnect.
acceptance: Run focused A3/A5/P9/SMB/VTI predecessor regressions plus PCV-03 negative/security/recovery tests and exact-head build/native checks.
Regenerate Windows and Android packages only from the repaired exact candidate head and bind the manifest to exact artifact hashes.

Installed evidence records causal receipts for distinct subject/device join, authoritative command, duplicate retry, disconnect, resume, ordered/gap-safe player delivery and hidden-before-publication filtering.
A second ordinary join cannot satisfy reconnect evidence and a single command cannot satisfy duplicate-idempotency evidence.
Device-side evidence binds installed Windows/Android runtime/package identity to the exact package artifact rather than relying only on self-reported wire metadata.
The physical Windows↔Android proof passes the strengthened verifier; only then may PCV-03 parent be considered completed_verified and PCV-04 become eligible.

Normal Campaign/Session connectivity exposes Create Campaign, a short human-friendly campaign locator/search flow, invite/connect by user id and one-click Connect; ordinary users never copy/paste raw bearer, SDP, ICE or giant signaling tokens.
Automatic rendezvous/signaling remains a replaceable non-authoritative adapter; manual signaling is retained only as hidden advanced recovery and does not appear in the ordinary Sessions journey.
boundaries: Certify only the repaired exact PCV-03 candidate; PCV-03F does not add gameplay, presence authority, Campaign/Session truth or a parallel recovery ledger.
Reuse BIP-01 package-production machinery. PCV-03F strengthens exact-head package manifest/install identity and causal certification evidence rather than becoming a second package builder.

Regenerate Windows x64 NSIS current-user installer and Android ARM64 direct-install APK only from the exact candidate head; manifest binds source head, build reference, application id/version, artifact SHA-256/size, protocol/schema compatibility and migration ids/checksums.

Windows evidence binds installed executable payload SHA-256 and records unsigned-beta explicitly unless signing is actually enabled. Android evidence binds applicationId/versionName/versionCode/targetSdk, APK hash, ABI set and signing-certificate digest/history.

Installed Windows and Android proofs require distinct fresh challenges and distinct registered non-exportable A3 device credentials; peer JSON self-report or human affirmation alone cannot certify install identity.

Causal physical evidence must distinguish ordinary join from reconnect, first command from duplicate retry, transport-A disconnect from transport-B fresh binding/resume, player batch apply/ACK from host command receipt, gap detection/recovery, stale-authorization denial, terminal invitation reuse denial, actor-spoof denial and hidden-before-publication filtering.
Sensitive invitation/resume secrets, private keys, SDP/ICE addresses, hidden payloads and cross-context private data are excluded from certification evidence.
Do not enable Tauri updater, public/store distribution, production credentials/signing, billing/subscriptions, paid acquisition or public launch in PCV-03F.
Current Android targetSdk is 36; do not add ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK merely for this tranche. Re-evaluate only if targetSdk reaches 37+ and LAN access requires it.
PCV-04 gameplay remains unauthorized until PCV-03F closes and the PCV-03 parent is completed_verified.
Use milestone-level OPS3 state only; no activity-journal instrumentation.

Owner-directed UX repair is authorized before certification because the prior candidate exposed unacceptable manual signaling. It may change Campaign/Session product presentation and signaling adapters but may not change canonical Campaign, membership, Session, Event or gameplay authority.

Campaign codes are locators, not secrets or authority. User ids are connection targets, not authentication proof. A3/A5 authorization and recipient-bound invitations still gate access underneath one-click UX.

next_action: Repair the user-facing Campaign/Session connection flow before certification. Normal flow: Create Campaign -> easy campaign identifier -> invite/search -> Connect. Direct player connection: user id -> Connect. Raw bearer/SDP/ICE/manual response text must be absent from normal product UI; manual signaling may remain only as advanced recovery. Rebuild and certify the repaired exact head.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner rejected exposed long-token/manual-signaling connection UX. PCV-03F final certification candidate must instead expose Create Campaign, short campaign locator/search, user-id targeting and one-click Connect while keeping raw signaling hidden.

audit_required_at_closeout: PCV-03F must prove exact installed Windows/Android package identity with distinct device credentials and causal join/idempotency/disconnect-resume/ordered-gap-safe/hidden-projection receipts, while preserving PCV-03A..03E authority, excluding secrets/private evidence, and activating neither public release/updater nor PCV-04 gameplay before certification closes.

selection_basis.branch_rule: Create a fresh child-specific branch from current Multiversal-app main at execution start; do not reuse PCV-03E or the historical monolithic PCV-03 branch.

execution_conformance.execution_quality_note: PCV-03F automated work reached the physical-device evidence boundary, but the executor repeatedly polled a long-running Windows job and required repeated owner nudges instead of diagnosing/reporting the actual phase boundary promptly.

interaction_quality.classification: automated certification reached a genuine external physical-device blocker; executor polling behavior caused avoidable repeated owner intervention

connection_ux.failure_rule: Any normal flow that requires copying/pasting bearer, SDP, ICE or giant signaling tokens fails acceptance.
